critical_code_review_comments: ContentCard.jsx: image alt uses English item.title but card also displays title_native — consider using title_native for alt to improve a11y for RTL users, or a combined descriptive alt. Minor.
Preview images use loading='lazy' which is good, but no width/height attributes on can cause CLS. Consider adding width/height or aspect-ratio styles beyond the wrapper's h-48.
